decisions.reason: Approving Inter changes body typography but does not change the existing prohibition on article-end whitespace or the approved filler strategy.
The body-typeface decision does not alter where red may be used.
Inter is approved for article body text, but the source does not modify the independent polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The typeface approval does not change the required layout work, supplied inputs, or Flat Plan arrangement basis.
The approved article body typeface has no necessary effect on advertisement rendering sharpness.
Selecting Inter does not change the table-of-contents completion timing or page-number accuracy rule.
The current issue's body-typeface approval does not cancel or modify the requested word-count guidance for future issues.
The source changes body typography only and does not alter category content, placement, or presentation requirements.
Approving Inter does not change the requirement to remediate article image quality when necessary.
The typeface decision does not change the designated source of article content.
The approved body typeface does not change which cover-listed articles must be included or who places them.
The article body-typeface approval does not modify the cover page-number accuracy requirement.
